record.hypothesis: Construct a per-category item-frequency feature from training interactions only: f_i=log(1+count_i)/max_j log(1+count_j). Multiply each input item embedding by the fixed scalar 1-0.3*f_i, leaving padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This may reduce domination by common historical items. Preserve embedding parameters, causal convolutions, positions, readout, loss and optimizer; save the frequency vector with each model and apply the identical transformation in the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Downweight frequent historical items using training-only normalized log frequencies. Apply the fixed factor 1-0.3*f_i only to input item embeddings. Preserve learned embeddings, positions, causal convolutions, readout, loss and optimizer. The persistent frequency buffer is saved in each category checkpoint; the existing predictor writer imports the updated model class and restores that buffer automatically.
